They move their hips and arms in time with a rhythm. Behind them are several modified trucks, one pink and one green, adorned with flowers and large display boards. A diverse crowd of people is standing in the foreground, watching and recording with their smartphones. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of a man in his 30s with short hair, wearing a black textured shirt, a gold necklace, and a white smartwatch. He is wearing dark aviator sunglasses and sipping through a straw from a light blue cup. Behind him, other men in blue and black shirts are visible. Suddenly, a hand reaches from behind and lifts his sunglasses, revealing his eyes looking slightly upward and to the side. (3) The man breaks into a sheepish smile and chuckle as the sunglasses are lowered back onto his face. He continues to hold the cup and straw. (4) The scene returns to a wider shot of the dancers in the background, showing the perspective of the crowd. A pink-shirted man and a woman with long dark hair are prominent in the foreground, watching the performance.
